as_told.title: Pyramids aligned with Orion's Belt as a place where souls ascend

plain: The three great pyramids at Giza are said to be laid out to match the three stars of Orion's Belt, a line of stars in the constellation Orion. Michels says the layout "mapped fully" to the belt around 10,600 BC, when the sky shifted into that position. The writer Graham Hancock, known for his books on lost ancient civilizations, talks about the pyramids lining up with Orion's Belt without giving a date. He says the belt "has always, across many cultures, been the place of ascension of souls." If true, it would mean the builders laid out the ground to mirror the heavens.
